verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਉਂ ਕਪੂਰ ਨਾ ਚਖਈ ਦੁਰਗੰਧਿ ਸੁਖਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: kaau(n) kapoor naa chakhiee dhuraga(n)dh sukhaavai|

en.bdb: Crow never picks up camphor; it likes to have garbage around.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਾਥੀ ਨੀਰਿ ਨ੍ਹਵਾਲੀਐ ਸਿਰਿ ਛਾਰੁ ਉਡਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: haathee neer nhavaaleeaai sir chhaar uddaavai|

en.bdb: The elephant even bathed in water puts dust on its head.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੁੰਮੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਿੰਜੀਐ ਕਉੜਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: tu(n)me a(n)mirat si(n)jeeaai kauRat na jaavai|

en.bdb: The colocynth (tumma) even if irrigated with nectar does not part with its bitterness.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਲੁ ਰੁਖੁ ਸਰੇਵੀਐ ਫਲੁ ਹਥਿ ਨਾ ਆਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: simal rukh sareveeaai fal hath naa aavai|

en.bdb: Even if the silk-cotton tree is well served (with water and manure etc.), no fruit is gained from it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣਿਆ ਸਤਿਸੰਗ ਨਾ ਭਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: ni(n)dhak naam vihooniaa satisa(n)g naa bhaavai|

en.bdb: The backbiters being devoid of the neim of the Lord, do not like the holy congregation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਨ੍ਹਾ ਆਗੂ ਜੇ ਥੀਐ ਸਭੁ ਸਾਥੁ ਮੁਹਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit_en: a(n)nhaa aagoo je theeaai sabh saath muhaavai ||2||

en.bdb: If the leader is blind, the whole company is bound to be robbed of (their valuables).
